name: Verify power-cap for a single node

steps.name: Stage 0: Retrieve a compute node from HSM to be used in later stages
Stage 1: Set target node state to Off
Stage 2: Set target node state to Ready
Stage 3: Create a power-cap snapshot for the target node
Stage 4: Retrieve the power-cap snapshot for the target node
Stage 5: Retrieve the completed power-cap snapshot for the target node
Stage 6: Set a power-cap of the minimum value on the target node
Stage 7: Retrieve the power-cap patch for the target node and minimum power cap value
Stage 8: Retrieve the completed power-cap patch for the target node and minimum power cap value
Stage 9: Set a power-cap of the maximum value on the target node
Stage 10: Retrieve the power-cap patch for the target node and maximum power cap value
Stage 11: Retrieve the completed power-cap patch for the target node and maximum power cap value
Stage 12: Attempt to set a power-cap greater than the maximum value on the target node
Stage 13: Retrieve the power-cap patch for the target node and power cap value above maximum
Stage 14: Retrieve the completed power-cap patch for the target node and power cap value above maximum
Stage 15: Attempt to set a power-cap lower than the minimum value on the target node
Stage 16: Retrieve the power-cap patch for the target node and power cap value below minimum
Stage 17: Retrieve the completed power-cap patch for the target node and power cap value below minimum
Stage 18: Set a power-cap of zero on the target node
Stage 19: Retrieve the power-cap patch for the target node and power cap value of zero
Stage 20: Retrieve the completed power-cap patch for the target node and power cap of zero
Stage 21: Restore the original power-cap value on the target node
Stage 22: Retrieve the power-cap patch for the target node and original power cap value
Stage 23: Retrieve the completed power-cap patch for the target node and original power cap value
Stage 24: Prepare to restore the original state of the target node by setting it to Off
Stage 25: Restore the original state of the target node
